section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study investigating the mediating role of social support in the relationship between gratitude and loneliness among 728 Chinese college students. The study utilized the Gratitude Questionnaire-6, UCLA Loneliness Scale (version 3), and Social Support Rating Scale. The authors hypothesize that gratitude will be negatively related to loneliness and that social support will mediate this relationship, aiming to contribute new information and empirical evidence to alleviate loneliness.
